title: Grade 2 French — Wed, Jun 18
description: Porter — Day 3 of 5: Verb 'porter' (to wear) — Je porte, tu portes...
subject: french

questions.question: What does the verb 'porter' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Porter' means to wear (clothes) or to carry (something). Today we focus on 'to wear'.

questions.question: 'Je porte' means:
questions.explanation: 'Je porte' = I wear. 'Je' = I; 'porte' = wear (first person form of 'porter').

questions.question: 'Tu portes' means:
questions.explanation: 'Tu portes' = you wear (informal, talking to a friend or child). 'Tu' = you.

questions.question: 'Il / Elle porte' means:
questions.explanation: 'Il porte' = he wears; 'Elle porte' = she wears. Same verb form for he and she!

questions.question: 'Nous portons' means:
questions.explanation: 'Nous portons' = we wear. 'Nous' = we. This is the 'nous' (we) form of porter.

questions.question: Translate: 'I wear a red t-shirt.'
questions.explanation: 'Je porte un t-shirt rouge.' = I wear a red t-shirt. 'Rouge' = red; 't-shirt' is masculine so 'un'.

questions.question: Translate: 'She wears a blue dress.'
questions.explanation: 'Elle porte une robe bleue.' = She wears a blue dress. 'Elle' = she; 'une robe bleue' = a blue dress (feminine).

questions.question: Translate: 'He wears black trousers.'
questions.explanation: 'Il porte un pantalon noir.' = He wears black trousers. 'Noir' = black; 'pantalon' is masculine.

questions.question: Fill in: 'Tu ___ un manteau vert.' (You wear a green coat.)
questions.explanation: 'Tu portes' — 'tu' always takes '-es' ending. 'Tu portes un manteau vert.' = You wear a green coat.

questions.question: Which form is correct? 'Ma sœur ___ une jupe rose.'
questions.explanation: 'Ma sœur porte' — she (elle) wears. The form 'porte' is used for il/elle. Correct: 'Ma sœur porte une jupe rose.'

questions.question: Complete: 'Aujourd'hui, je ___ un pull jaune et des chaussettes blanches.'
questions.explanation: 'Je porte' — first person singular. 'Today I wear a yellow sweater and white socks.'

questions.question: Describe what you are wearing today using 'je porte':
options: Je porte un t-shirt et un pantalon.
Tu portes un t-shirt et un pantalon.
Il porte un t-shirt et un pantalon.
Elle porte un t-shirt et un pantalon.
questions.explanation: 'Je porte' is 'I wear'. Only the first option starts with 'Je porte' — the correct form for describing what you yourself wear.

questions.question: REVIEW: 'Nous portons des chaussures noires.' means:
questions.explanation: 'Nous portons' = we wear. 'Des chaussures noires' = black shoes (plural).

questions.question: Choose the correct translation: 'He wears a white hat.'
questions.explanation: 'Il porte un chapeau blanc.' He = il; hat (chapeau) = masculine (un); white = blanc (masculine).

questions.question: WEEK STAR: Describe a friend's outfit using 'il porte' or 'elle porte' + colour:
options: Il porte un t-shirt rouge et un pantalon bleu.
Je porte un t-shirt rouge et un pantalon bleu.
questions.explanation: 'Il porte un t-shirt rouge et un pantalon bleu.' = He wears a red t-shirt and blue trousers. Best use of verb + clothes + colours in one sentence!
